propositions: LSP symbol tools (Serena find_referencing_symbols) cannot resolve symbols referenced by string literals like monkeypatch.setattr, causing real call sites to be missed
AGENTS.md currently states an unconditional preference for LSP symbol tools over grep that is factually incorrect in cases involving string-literal symbol references
LSP indexes can lag behind recent file edits, causing reported line numbers to be stale compared to the working tree
The bare preference rule in AGENTS.md trains agents to discount it entirely when they encounter cases it handles incorrectly, contributing to actual failures

AGENTS.md must replace the unconditional preference with a decision table specifying when to use find_referencing_symbols (semantic lookup), grep (string literals and comments), and grep on working tree (current line numbers)
